rationale: For an analytics dashboard connecting Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, the objective is high fidelity, clear data correlation, and authoritative action. Using a Swiss & High-Contrast design ensures the metrics are incredibly legible and professional, avoiding decorative clutter while highlighting actionable operational insights.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant for dashboards: authoritative headings with stark sterile body.

rules: Tracking must be extremely tight (`tracking-tighter`) for >32px.
Use font-black for major KPIs, font-light for elegant subtitles.
Line height: leading-relaxed for paragraphs, leading-none for table cells.
Color is Function Only. 95% of UI should be monochrome.
Use data_viz colors exclusively for charts, sparklines, and metric indicators.
Hover states must be explicitly declared, e.g., hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900.

layout_and_spacing.protocol: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID

spacing.generous: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.

alignment.general: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align tables and lists. Top-left North Star metrics (F-pattern).

header.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-200/50 shadow-sm

badges.classes: px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200

icons.rationale: Phosphor Icons provide excellent legibility for dense dashboards and data tools.

rules: Left aligned text, right aligned numbers.

shadcn: Card (Customized to be flat with 1px border)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js and .jsx extensions exclusively (NO TypeScript/.tsx).
Use pure functional components with Tailwind CSS for layout.
Implement the 'Control Room' Grid exactly as specified, with dense spacing but generous padding inside cards.
Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Use 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Add these to your index.html or global css.
Integrate Phosphor icons as the primary icon set.
Build the dashboard focusing on the North Star Metrics (F-Pattern).
Every interactive or informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
